ValidationRule.description: When the picklist value for field Tanium Infrastructure Required is Yes – Tanium as a Service, Duration days must fall between 1 - 30 for both New and Extension POC Type. #INC0168419 - Remove "Duration<>90" after "1/31/22"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( Account__r.RecordTypeId ='01260000000Q6hS', AND(OR(Duration__c < 1, Duration__c > 60), ISPICKVAL( Tanium_Infrastructure__c , "Yes – Tanium as a Service"), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Promotion__c , "Performance Promo (Expires 1/31/22)")),NOT(ISPICKVAL( Promotion__c , "ITSC"))), AND(OR(Duration__c < 1, Duration__c > 30), ISPICKVAL( Tanium_Infrastructure__c , "Yes – Tanium as a Service"),NOT(ISPICKVAL( Promotion__c , "Performance Promo (Expires 1/31/22)")),NOT(ISPICKVAL( Promotion__c , "ITSC"))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Duration days must fall between 1 - 60 when Tanium Infrastructure Required selection is Yes - Tanium as a Service for a Partner Account or It should fall between 1 - 30 when Tanium Infrastructure Required Selection is Yes - Tanium as a Service.
